## What size do you actually need?

| RV usage | Recommended capacity |
|---|---:|
| Lights, phones, laptops | 500–1,000Wh |
| Refrigerator, lights, electronics | 1,200–2,000Wh |
| Weekend boondocking | 2,000–3,000Wh |
| Extended off-grid camping | 3,000–5,000Wh+ |
| Heavy appliances and AC | 4,000Wh+ and suitable inverter |

A critical detail: Battery capacity and inverter output are different things. A 2,000Wh battery doesn't necessarily have enough output to start an air conditioner.

Also, a TT-30 outlet doesn't mean the unit supplies the full 30A RV service. Check the actual current and wattage limits. A 2,400W inverter is approximately 20A at 120V.
